title: ARGENTINA WANT MESSI BACK. JUST NOT ON THE PITCH.
description:
He retired from Argentina in August. Argentina have already offered him a new job.

Argentina have offered Lionel Messi a staff job. Presumably with a clipboard. He retired at 39, so this is retired from playing, not from being asked. Scaloni says Messi is welcome to come, now that Walter Samuel is leaving. Subtle timing.

Messi hasn't replied. Scaloni says he already said no, which makes it a very quiet interview.

Meanwhile, on the pitch, he scored 26 league goals and made 17 assists. That earned a second straight Golden Boot, a first for MLS. A quiet year, then. The staff job can wait.
